objective: Build a local Mac automation app that records video using OBS Studio with a Sony camera, MacBook camera, microphone, and screen capture. The system should make recording one-click, scriptable, and reliable.

hardware: Sony camera connected via HDMI capture card or USB webcam mode

important_assumptions: OBS Studio is installed separately by the user.
Sony camera appears in OBS as a Video Capture Device through HDMI capture card or USB webcam mode.
The app controls OBS through OBS WebSocket on localhost port 4455.
The software should not directly control Sony camera settings in v1 unless a future SDK module is added.
Recording output is handled by OBS.
non_goals_v1: Do not build a full GUI in v1.
Do not implement direct Sony SDK camera control in v1.
Do not upload videos to YouTube in v1.
Do not require admin privileges unless absolutely necessary.

mvp.name: OBS connection test
mvp.description: Connect to OBS WebSocket and verify that OBS is reachable.

mvp.name: Scene bootstrapper
mvp.description: Create or verify core OBS scenes for recording.

mvp.name: Source verification
mvp.description: List available OBS sources and help user map Sony camera, MacBook camera, microphone, and display capture.

mvp.name: Recording controls
mvp.description: Start, stop, pause, resume, and check recording status.

mvp.name: Recording profiles
mvp.description: Support named profiles such as talking_head, screen_tutorial, dual_camera, and screen_plus_camera.

mvp.name: Output folder management
mvp.description: Save recordings into organized date-based folders.

mvp.name: Health check
mvp.description: Verify OBS is open, websocket is available, sources exist, and output path is writable.

mvp.name: Local API server
mvp.description: Expose endpoints for start/stop/status so future tools can control recording.

future.name: Sony SDK integration
future.description: Add direct Sony camera control using Sony Camera Remote SDK, libsonyapi, or gphoto2 where supported.

future.name: Stream Deck support
future.description: Add hotkey/webhook integration for physical control.

future.name: Auto-upload pipeline
future.description: Send finished recordings to Google Drive, YouTube, or local processing queue.

future.name: AI post-production
future.description: Transcribe, summarize, trim silence, create clips, and generate metadata.

cli_commands.description: Switch to profile scene and start recording.

api_endpoints.description: Return app and OBS health status.

implementation_requirements: Use Pydantic models for config validation.
Use Rich for readable terminal output.
Use obsws-python for all OBS WebSocket calls.
Fail gracefully if OBS is closed.
Fail gracefully if OBS WebSocket password is wrong.
Fail gracefully if a source or scene does not exist.
Provide useful error messages with exact fix instructions.
Create date-based output folders if possible.
Keep the system local-first and privacy-preserving.

talking_head.layout: Sony camera full-screen with microphone audio.

screen_tutorial.layout: Screen capture full-screen with microphone audio.

dual_camera.layout: Sony camera primary, MacBook camera picture-in-picture.

screen_plus_camera.layout: Screen capture full-screen with Sony camera picture-in-picture.

testing_requirements: Do not require actual OBS connection for unit tests.
Add manual integration test instructions for OBS.
readme_requirements: Explain how to enable OBS WebSocket.
Explain how to map OBS source names to config.yaml.
Explain how to run doctor command.
Explain how to start and stop recording.
obs_setup_doc_requirements: Go to Tools > WebSocket Server Settings.
Add Sony camera as Video Capture Device.
Add MacBook camera as Video Capture Device.
Add microphone as Audio Input Capture.
Make sure source names match config.yaml.
sony_setup_doc_requirements: Option 1: Sony HDMI output into capture card.
Option 2: Sony USB webcam mode if camera supports it.
Set camera to clean HDMI output when using capture card.
Use dummy battery or USB-C power for long recordings.
Set resolution and frame rate to match OBS settings.
Confirm the camera appears as a source in OBS.
acceptance_criteria: User can run `recording-auto doctor` and receive clear pass/fail checks.
User can run `recording-auto sources list` and see OBS sources.
User can run `recording-auto scenes bootstrap` without crashing.
User can run `recording-auto start --profile talking_head` and OBS starts recording.
User can run `recording-auto stop` and OBS stops recording.
User can run local API and control recording through HTTP.

instructions: Create the full repository from this specification.
Write useful README and setup docs.
Add tests that can run without OBS installed.
Return a final summary of files created and exact commands to run.
